chunks: O believers, do not make others except your own people your confidants. They will spare no effort to ruin you: They surely desire your annihilation. Hate is on their tongues, and what they hide in their hearts is worse. We have shown you the signs if you have sense.

key_terms.بِطَانَة: Confidant; a close companion or intimate friend with whom one shares secrets

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about choosing close confidants and hidden enmity?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the incident of the hypocrites (Munafiqun) who feigned loyalty to the Prophet while secretly plotting against the Muslim community, emphasizing the virtue of *Taqiyyah* (prudence in concealment) when dealing with insincere allies. It serves as a foundational text for understanding social dynamics within the early Islamic community, where outward conformity did not guarantee inner faithfulness. The term *bitanah* specifically denotes intimate confidants, warning believers that even those close to them may harbor deeper enmity than their words suggest.
